capabilities: Anchor comments to selected text spans in Live Preview, source mode and reading view
List, reply to, resolve, reopen and delete threads in a side panel
Install an agent skill so coding agents can list, show, reply to, resolve and reopen threads
Refresh the thread panel when thread files change on disk
Resolve links by frontmatter id and aliases (optional setting)
disambiguation: Not an AI chat plugin; it stores anchored comments beside notes, and agents participate only through a skill file the plugin installs.
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installed via BRAT or manual file copy; does not run on mobile; the plugin never uses the network and format details live in a separate FORMAT.md.
problem: Comment plugins that write discussions into the note itself (e.g. as CriticMarkup) leave no clean way for an external coding agent to read and answer the discussion.

relations.evidence: Some comment plugins write the discussion into the note itself as CriticMarkup, while Agent Threads keeps every thread in its own file
.claude/skills/agent-threads/ | When .claude/ exists at the vault root | Claude Code

summary: Annotation plugin that anchors comment threads to text spans in notes, stores them as JSON files, and lets coding agents read and reply via an installed skill.
